title: Research sprint goal: Census deterministic 1: measured baseline, one driver, phase-2 bookkeeping by tool

No kb facts or gap entries are needed.
notes: Goal questions packed 2026-10-10: 'what does census phase 2 read and how is it grouped by owner', 'how does tests.py write the test.run ops row', 'what does the kb-census skill run in phase 3' are weak in --root _self and are read from the code by the stories themselves; 'how many characters per token does Claude count, token counting estimate' is good in the public kb.
